# Florent Berrez

> Software engineer in Paris, France. Builds small, focused products — desktop tools, developer ergonomics, quiet web things. Keyboard-first when it matters, boring tech, considered defaults.

## About

- **Name:** Florent Berrez (also: Flo Berrez, fberrez)
- **Role:** Software engineer
- **Location:** Paris, France
- **Website:** https://www.fberrez.co
- **Email:** hi@fberrez.co

- **Company:** mambo-corp (https://github.com/mambo-corp)
- **Philosophy:** Ships a lot of small things rather than one big thing.

## Currently shipping

- [mambo](https://trymambo.app): Keyboard-driven desktop database client for macOS and Linux. Connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, ClickHouse, DuckDB, Elasticsearch, and Cassandra. Flagship project. Built with Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript.
- [blurt.sh](https://blurt.sh): The simplest way to publish on the web. Push markdown, send an email, or just write. Your blog is live. Zero-config.
- [quietdash.com](https://quietdash.com): A quiet dashboard. Numbers that matter, nothing that doesn't. Single-screen metrics view.
- [minihabits](https://minihabits.co): A minimalist habit tracking app. One screen, tap, done, streak. No onboarding, no settings, no notifications.

## Stack

TypeScript, React, Astro, NestJS, Tauri, Node.js, Rust, Go, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker.
